text: Twenty videos ago, Fairmont ran its entire harvest on one aging server with no backup. This is the last video: how Dante tells this whole project as one story, in an interview.
Situation and Task: a co-op with no offsite backup and a six-week harvest spike it couldn't scale for -- his job was a hybrid Azure and AWS platform that could survive both.

Action: he built it, found a security rule that had never matched a single pod since the day it was applied, traced it through a cost anomaly instead of a crash alert, and made sure it couldn't happen silently again.
Result: one well-understood, fully reconciled forty-minute incident, a fix pattern audited across the whole platform, and leadership that trusts the system because they were told the truth about it.
That's the whole story, start to finish -- bugs and all.
